# Designing Dark Elves

*Page PDF 120*

## **Patrons and Nemeses**
## **Designing Dark Elves**
An encounter with a dark elf is an encounter with a villain, as even a lowly servant or footslogging dreadspear is motivated by devious ambition. You can use the profiles and templates in **Chapter 4** to quickly create NPCs, but if you want to create a heinous arch-enemy or untrustworthy ally from scratch, use these guidelines. 

## **Name**
Dark elf names bear some similarity to Asur names, but with subtly different elements that reflect Nagarythe culture and subsequent darker influences. First names can be built from 2–3 components like a high elf or wood elf name (see the **WFRP Core Rulebook** ). 

Warrior names typically comprise two components, such as ‘Severspite’ or ‘Redblade’. Pick or adapt a combination from this list, or invent your own: 

- **Colours and tones:** Black, Blue, Dark, Ebon, Green, Grey, Pale, Red, Silver, White 

- **Unpleasant verbs:** Cleave, Damn, Flay, Grasp, Hack, Harm, Harrow, Kill, Maim, Mourn, Reave, Rend, Sever, Slay, Slice, Spear, Stalk, Tear, Whisper, Wither 

- **Anatomy:** Blood, Bone, Claw, Eye, Fang, Flesh, Hand, Heart, Scale, Spine, Talon, Venom, Wing 

- **Natural phenomena:** Ash, Chill, Cold, Dawn, Dusk, Flame, Gale, Mist, Night, Splinter, Storm, Thorn, Wave, Wind 

**Second First component Ending component (optional)** Aen, An, Cyn, ag, ar, br, da, dra, ach, aen, agh, akh, Dran, Gh, Har, dy, el, er, eth, for, ain, alla, anph, Hek, Hel, Jer, il, ir, is, kk, la, lir, aria, arth,  ath, Kel, Kha, Khe, na, nar, nel, rae, del, ella, eth, hesh, Khy, Lo, Mal, ris, sel, sha, ss, syl, ial, iel, illa, ion, Mor, Na, Ne, ta, tar, th, tyr, ul, khar, lath, lith, Rae, Ra, Rhu, vel, vor, yl nar, nil, rith, ron, Sab, Sab, See, thir, url, us Sil, Vy, Ynn, Zel 

- **Unpleasant emotions:** Brood, Dread, Hate, Hollow, Scorn, Sorrow, Spite, Woe 

- **Adjectives:** Bleak, Cruel, Far, Grim, Quick, Stark, Swift 

- **Unpleasant nouns:** Bane, Blade, Doom, Hel, Hex, Poison, Witch, Wither, Wrack 

- **Other nouns:** Adder, Hawk, Hood, Mantle, Mask, Veil

## **Species Skills and Talents**
## **Warrior Names**
**Skills:** Bribery, Charm, Cool, Dodge, Evaluate, Intuition, Gossip, Language (Elthárin), Melee (Basic), Navigation, Perception, Stealth (Any One) 

Dark elves frequently adopt a warrior name to strike fear into the hearts of allies and enemies. Such a name declares that they have committed great and vile deeds themselves, rather than living in the shadow of their forbears. Curiously, some warrior names (such as Helbane) are handed down, providing that any subsequent bearer proves themselves worthy of the deed which informs the name, or the reputation it carries. 

**Talents:** Acute Sense (Sight), Hatred (High Elves), Savvy _or_ Schemer, Night Vision, Second Sight _or_ Sixth Sense, Read/Write
